name: Tube2
purpose: Tube-style saturation: warm even harmonics and soft clipping with an input trim; a rounder, thicker alternative to Console8 or tape.
avoid_for: material that must stay clean and dynamic
notes: All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Tube2 is designed to top out at 0 dB, so heavy input can raise the level: trim later in the chain.
CPU: 0.26% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.

expose.ai_hint: Input trim into the tube. 0.5 is roughly level-matched; raise it to push the tube harder (louder, denser), lower it to pad the signal back.
Amount of tube behaviour. Lower is more linear; higher is softer and more saturated. 0.3-0.5 for gentle warmth on a vocal, 0.7+ for obvious tube grit.
